title: CareSentryAttentionScoreOutput
description: Output schema for CareSentry-AI attention probe Z-score auditing

model_id.description: Identifier of the target language model evaluated

target_needle.description: The exact clinical constraint substring probed

target_span_tokens.description: Token indices spanning the target needle

target_attention_mean.description: Mean cross-head attention received by target span across evaluated layers

control_spans_count.description: Number of randomized control spans sampled (minimum 20)

control_attention_mean.description: Mean attention weight across all control spans

control_attention_std.description: Standard deviation of attention weights across control spans

z_score.description: Empirical attention Z-score normalized against control distribution

classification.description: Attention categorization based on Z thresholds (+1.0, -0.5)

layers_analyzed.description: Transformer layer indices included in the decision window (e.g. final 4 layers)

mitigation_triggered.description: True if Z < -0.5 necessitating automated context remediation

mitigation_strategy.description: Applied prompt remediation strategy if triggered
